text: Why does this cap just click when you turn it?
It's really two caps. The inner one is screwed on. The outer one is loose.
Between them are sloped teeth. Turn to open, and the top teeth ride up the slopes and slip off.
Click. The inner cap never moves.
Push down, and they can't ride up. Now they grip, and both caps turn together.
Turning alone just slips. Push and turn, and it opens.
